Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

9. Revision of pension.When pension is revised, the Bank / P.O. on receipt of the amendment letter from the authority who issued the PPO, will obtain the pensioner's half from the pensioner and carry out the corrections in both the halfs of PPO. The pensioner's half of PPO will be returned to the pensioner. The additional amount due will be credited in the account of the pensioner.
